Thanks for the ping — shared a short technical assessment below and attached detailed notes + cost CSV. TL;DR: start with Hosted pilot in us-west-2 for time-to-value, plan Dedicated reserve in us-east-1 for production, consider Private only if ACME's legal requires physical isolation.

Technical summary:
- Hosted (us-west-2):
  - KMS: Redwood hosted KMS integration available; we can bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via AWS KMS in most cases.
  - Audit logs: full request/response audit logs available; can stream to customer's CloudWatch/S3 with short retention or longer per contract.
  - Latency: median p50 ~20ms for 1–2k concurrent users from US west; fine for pilot but east coast will see +30–40ms network delta.
  - Provisioning: immediate, pilot-ready in <24 hours.

- Dedicated (us-east-1):
  - KMS: supports BYOK & customer-managed keys; we can place Dedicated GPU pools in the selected region.
  - Audit logs & retention: configurable per contract; supports extended retention and encrypted archive.
  - Latency: lower intra-region latency for east-coast customers; p50 ~12–15ms if colocated.
  - Provisioning: reserve lead time 3–7 business days for initial node(s) depending on availability.

- Private (VPC / On-prem):
  - KMS: customer-managed HSM / KMS only — we do not retain keys.
  - Auditability: full control, integrates with on-prem syslog/SIEM.
  - Latency: best when co-located; operational overhead higher and provisioning can be multi-week.
  - Provisioning: 2–6 weeks depending on network approvals and on-prem scheduling.

Recommendation & costs:
- Pilot: Hosted in us-west-2 (fastest to validate features).
- Production: Dedicated in us-east-1 (best balance of cost, latency, & compliance for ACME).
- Private: fallback if legal requires physical isolation (we can scope SOW).

Attachments: techno_eval_notes.txt, cost_estimate_hosted_vs_dedicated.csv

Happy to jump on a 30-minute tech alignment with ACME and procurement this week.

—Vivek
